status_note: one seed of the Q003 harness: evidence only when run at the pinned scale with the full strong arm from the frozen commit and judged by aggregate.py under criteria.toml; the exit status and the coverage and falsifiers lists below are the harness's own reading of the same rules

measurement_notes.oracle: the live table is the harness's own record built from the workload's events (oracle.rs); every hit of every list (lexical, vector, fused) of every product answer, probes included, is held against it, and the product's is_admissible is compared with it for every capsule and generation at both checkpoints (lifecycle_projection_mismatches)
measurement_notes.planted: stale rows are inserted by raw SQL into the derived table, bypassing upsert_document, to simulate index lag or a failed delete: superseded generations and revoked generations (whose live_generation row still names them), planted before the queries of each checkpoint; a planted row is a near duplicate of the live document and matches the same queries
measurement_notes.late_writes: upsert_document of a non-live generation (superseded, revoked, ahead of the live one, or of a capsule never committed) must be refused with NotLive and store no row; any other outcome is late_write_accepted or late_write_wrong_refusal
measurement_notes.probes: the main queries are natural-language questions, which plainto_tsquery ANDs term by term, so the lexical mode rarely matches them; the stale probes (a planted row's own body as the query) and the live probes (a live body) are what exercise the lexical lifecycle join and show the lexical mode returns hits; probes are audited for stale hits and are never part of recall
measurement_notes.control: the no-live-join control runs the same two queries without the lifecycle join on the stale probes; the exact lexical mode must return the planted row of every probe (else exit 2) and control_planted_returned counts both modes
measurement_notes.baselines: rag_reference and strong_retrieval are rebuilt from the live table at each checkpoint, so they hold no stale rows by construction; a baseline hit is never audited for staleness; the baselines are not under test and any failure of a driver is exit 2
measurement_notes.recall: recall@10 and nDCG@10 are over the answerable queries, the relevant document being the live generation of the target capsule; revoked targets are unanswerable and excluded; PG is the fused list of the product's search (limit 40 per mode, equal weights, k 60); descriptive: the PG lexical and vector lists alone and the BM25 list alone
measurement_notes.wall_time: timing_ns and latency_ns are recorded and never judged; strong_arm_ns is the wall time the strong driver took (loading and queries); the reranker runs in fp32 on shared CPU
